facts.fact: The Ministry's page of 2025-07-09 sets the sector's strategic goal of 7 million households on fixed internet by the end of 2027, with FTTH as the core technology, so the period had not ended.

The Ministry reports 6.6 million fixed internet subscribers in the first half of 2025, up from 3.5 million in early 2020, against its goal of 7 million households by end-2027, and says the intermediate objectives were reached.

systems.owner: Ministry of Post and Telecommunications; Algerie Telecom operates the network under Art. 29 of law 18-04
